[[Disruption#Disruption | Disruption]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Disruption#Disruption | Disruption]]:''' On Hit: 4 to 24 [[Bane]] damage to [[Undead]].
On [[Vorpal Strike|Vorpal Hit]]: If an undead struck by this weapon has fewer than 1000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the undead has above 1000 Hit Points, it takes 100 damage.
